title: 第19章 暗涌 下第20章 伙房之外 上
slug: 修仙开局一部手机修为全靠买
content_zh:
“世人皆言剑修之要在力在速，余以为大谬。力可积，速可练，唯悟不可强求。悟从何来？一曰观剑，二曰试剑，三曰破剑。观他人之剑以开眼界，试自身之剑以明长短，破心中之剑以见真章。”
观剑、试剑、破剑。三句话，概括了剑修悟性的三个层次。刘叙白反复读了这一段，又联想到《悟道剑诀》总纲里那句“悟通则万法通”，心里忽然多了一层理解——之前他一直把《悟道剑诀》当成一门功法来练，但写这篇笔记的前辈显然把“悟”本身也当成了一种修炼。观剑是最基础的，多看多学；试剑是实践，在实战中打磨；破剑则是最高层次，破的不是外在的剑招，是心中的执念和偏见。
刘叙白放下玉简，低头看了看苏清欢给他的那柄青鞘长剑。剑鞘上那朵梅花纹样在阅览室昏暗的光线里依然清晰可辨。他想起苏清欢在青石镇后山教他缠风式的时候，松枝画出的那个圈——那种圆融自如的剑感，他到现在也只能模仿七八成。
观剑、试剑、破剑。他现在连观剑都还没做足。画梅宗两脉并立，流云峰是剑修主脉，这里的剑道底蕴足够他钻研很长时间。
他把玉简放回原处，又抽了几本关于炼气期修行要诀和修真界基础常识的玉简，一一翻阅。时间过得飞快，直到肚子叫了，他才发现已经是午后了。
走出藏经阁的时候，冬日的阳光正从云缝里漏下来，满山松枝反射着碎金般的光斑。刘叙白站在石阶上，眯着眼望向远处的寒潭谷方向。从流云峰的半山腰看过去，寒潭谷就在两座雪峰之间最深处的一片盆地里，谷中终年积雪，连屋檐都是白的。阳光照不进谷底，远远望去像一口幽深的井。
小蝉就在那边的伙房里。
刘叙白收回目光，往回走。路上他在心里盘算着今天剩下的时间——中午去医舍给陈砚送点吃的，下午在客院里练剑，晚上去苏清欢那里吃饭。至于那枚剑意石，他想等今天晚上回来之后，趁着夜深人静的时候再尝试感悟。
走到医舍的时候，陈砚正在下床活动。他吊着左臂，右手扶着床沿，一步一步地在病房里慢慢走动。看到刘叙白进来，他咧嘴一笑：“叙白哥，大夫说我再躺两天就能拆夹板了。这地方的大夫就是厉害，在青石镇这种伤没一个月下不来床。”
刘叙白把路上从伙房顺的两个馒头和一碗炖菜放在床头柜上，又递给他一个油纸包：“腊肉，王屠户送的。伙房的病号饭太清淡，给你加个菜。”
陈砚接过油纸包，凑近闻了闻，眼睛顿时亮了。他一边撕腊肉一边往嘴里塞，含含糊糊地说：“对了，今天早上来了个人，穿白袍的，看起来很年轻。她在病房门口看了我一眼，问我是谁，我说我是刘叙白的兄弟。她点了点头就走了。她谁啊？”
“女弟子？长什么样？”
“挺秀气的，脸圆圆的，说话声音很轻。哦对了，她脑后面梳了两条麻花辫。”
刘叙白愣了一下，然后笑出了声。这形容既不是苏清欢也不是叶凝，倒像是——一个他刚认识不久却印象极好的小姑娘。“是阿宁。”
“阿宁？”陈砚瞪大了眼睛。
“阿木的外甥女，张婶的闺女。苏姑娘收她留在教里做一个外门小杂役。”刘叙白在床边坐下，把阿宁的事简单说了一遍。
陈砚听完之后，嚼了半天腊肉不再说话，忽然叹了口气：“这姑娘命苦，不过遇到你和苏姑娘，也算是转运了。你让她没事可以来我这里坐坐，一个人待在客院也没意思。”
刘叙白看着他，忽然明白了什么，嘴角弯起来：“她来看你的？”
陈砚的耳朵尖以肉眼可见的速度红了，一把抓起馒头堵住了自己的嘴，闷声闷气地说：“吃你的饭。”
傍晚时分，刘叙白如约去了苏清欢的院子。推开院门的时候，梅花的香气扑面而来——那棵老梅树上的花苞在暮色里悄悄绽开了几朵，粉白的花瓣在金色的夕阳余晖里微微颤动，像是刚刚醒来的蝴蝶。

苏清欢已经把饭菜摆在了正房厅堂的桌上。四菜一汤，比青石镇的骨头汤丰盛了不知多少倍——一碟清炒灵蔬、一盘红烧灵兽肉、一碗蒸蛋、一碟腌制的脆笋，外加一砂锅热气腾腾的菌菇汤。两副碗筷，两杯清茶，简单却不敷衍。
“这都是伙房送来的？”刘叙白在桌边坐下，有些意外。
“菜是我自己做的。”苏清欢在他对面坐下，拿起筷子，语气平淡，“流云峰弟子中，我的厨艺排名比剑术排名高。”
刘叙白夹了一筷子红烧肉放进嘴里，然后愣住了。肉质酥烂入味，酱汁咸甜适中，比他上辈子在任何一家餐馆吃过的红烧肉都好吃。他看着苏清欢，一时间不知道该说什么。
苏清欢低头夹菜，没看他的表情，但嘴角弯了一个极细微的弧度。
这顿饭吃得很安静。两个人谁都没有提宗门的事、丹药的事、韩知渊的事，只是就着饭菜和茶，聊了一些无关紧要的话题——流云峰的雪什么时候化，那棵老梅树今年能结多少梅子，陈砚的胳膊拆夹板之后需要恢复多久才能练剑。窗外的天色从金橘变成了灰蓝，又从灰蓝变成了深黑。梅花的香气从院子里飘进来，和饭菜的余温混在一起，把整个厅堂熏得暖意融融。
吃完饭之后，苏清欢收拾了碗筷。刘叙白帮她把砂锅端回灶房的时候，忽然问了一句：“小蝉长什么样？”
苏清欢手上的动作顿了一下，然后继续洗碗：“圆脸，皮肤偏黑，个子到我肩膀，左眼眼角有颗泪痣。”
“知道了。”
苏清欢转过头看着他，眼神里有一丝不解。
“你说小蝉在寒潭谷的伙房做杂役。寒潭谷的伙房，也是画梅宗的伙房。流云峰的弟子不能越界调人，但客院的外客去伙房讨碗热水喝，不算越界。”刘叙白把手擦干，语气随意，“我这人有个习惯，喜欢自己去伙房打热水。”
苏清欢看着他，好一会儿没有说话。然后她转过身继续洗碗，声音压得很低：“别冒进。韩知渊盯上你了，你走到哪里都会有人看着。”
“我知道。”刘叙白靠在灶房门框上，望着院子里那棵老梅树。星光落在梅枝上，把那些绽开的花瓣染成银白色。“但有些事，总得有人去做。”
他转过身朝院门走去，手习惯性地搁在腰间新佩的青鞘长剑上。
做得很自然。

content_en:
"Everyone in the world says that the key to sword cultivation lies in strength and speed, but I think it is a big mistake. Strength can be accumulated and speed can be practiced, but enlightenment cannot be forced. Where does enlightenment come from? The first is observing the sword, the second is testing the sword, and the third is breaking the sword. Watch other people's swords to open your eyes, test your own sword to know the length, and break the sword in your heart to see the true meaning."
Observe swords, test swords, and break swords. Three sentences summarize the three levels of sword cultivation comprehension. Liu Xubai read this paragraph over and over again, and then thought of the sentence in the general outline of "The Sword Art of Enlightenment" that "understanding is the master of all things", and he suddenly had an extra layer of understanding in his heart - he had always practiced "The Sword Art of Enlightenment" as a skill before, but the senior who wrote this note obviously regarded "enlightenment" itself as a kind of practice. Observing swords is the most basic, watch more and learn more; sword-testing is practice, polished in actual combat; breaking swords is the highest level, what is broken is not the external sword moves, but the obsession and prejudice in the heart.
Liu Xubai put down the jade slip and looked down at the green sheath sword that Su Qinghuan gave him. The plum blossom pattern on the scabbard is still clearly visible in the dim light of the reading room. He thought of the circle drawn by the pine branches when Su Qinghuan taught him the wind-winding style in the back mountain of Qingshi Town - that kind of smooth and smooth sword feel. He can only imitate 70% to 70% of it now.
Observe swords, test swords, and break swords. He hasn't even done enough sword watching yet. The two branches of Hua Mei Sect stand side by side, and Liuyunfeng is the main branch of sword cultivation. The foundation of swordsmanship here is enough for him to study for a long time.
He put the jade slips back to their original places, took out a few more jade slips on the key points of cultivation during the Qi Refining Period and basic knowledge of the world of cultivation, and read through them one by one. Time passed quickly, and he didn't realize it was already afternoon until his stomach growled.
When we walked out of the Sutra Pavilion, the winter sunshine was leaking through the gaps in the clouds, and the pine branches all over the mountain reflected light spots like broken gold. Liu Xubai stood on the stone steps, squinting and looking in the direction of Hantan Valley in the distance. Looking from halfway up Liuyun Peak, Hantan Valley is in the deepest basin between the two snow peaks. The valley is covered with snow all year round, and even the eaves are white. The sun doesn't reach the bottom of the valley, and it looks like a deep well from a distance.
Xiaochan is in the kitchen over there.
Liu Xubai withdrew his gaze and walked back. On the way, he mentally planned the rest of the day - going to the hospital to deliver some food to Chen Yan at noon, practicing swordplay in the guest house in the afternoon, and going to Su Qinghuan's place for dinner in the evening. As for the sword intention stone, he wanted to wait until he came back tonight and try to understand it in the dead of night.
When he walked to the hospital, Chen Yan was getting out of bed and moving. He hung his left arm and held the edge of the bed with his right hand, walking slowly in the ward step by step. Seeing Liu Xubai come in, he grinned: "Brother Xu Bai, the doctor said I can remove the splint if I lie down for two more days. The doctors here are really good. In Qingshi Town, I can't get out of bed for an injury like this in a month."
Liu Xubai put two steamed buns and a bowl of stew that he had picked up from the kitchen on the way on the bedside table, and handed him an oil paper bag: "Bacon, from Butcher Wang. The sick rice in the kitchen is too light, so I'll give you an extra vegetable."
Chen Yan took the oil paper bag and smelled it, his eyes suddenly brightened. He tore the bacon and stuffed it into his mouth, and said vaguely: "By the way, someone came here this morning. She was wearing a white robe and looked very young. She glanced at me at the door of the ward and asked me who I was. I said I was Liu Xubai's brother. She nodded and left. Who is she?"
"Female disciple? What does she look like?"
"Quite delicate, with a round face and a soft voice. Oh, by the way, she has two braids on the back of her head."
Liu Xubai was stunned for a moment, and then laughed out loud. This description was neither Su Qinghuan nor Ye Ning, but more like a little girl he had just met but had a very good impression of. "It's Aning."
"Aning?" Chen Yan's eyes widened.
"Amu's niece, Aunt Zhang's daughter. Miss Su took her to stay in the school as a servant." Liu Xubai sat down by the bed and briefly told about Aning.
After Chen Yan finished listening, he chewed half of theTian Larou stopped talking and suddenly sighed: "This girl has a hard life, but meeting you and Miss Su is a blessing. You can ask her to come to my place if she has nothing to do. There is no point in staying alone in the guest house."
Liu Xubai looked at him and suddenly understood something. The corners of his mouth curved up: "She came to see you?"
The tips of Chen Yan's ears turned red at a speed that was visible to the naked eye. He grabbed the steamed bun and blocked his mouth. He said in a muffled voice: "Eat your food."
In the evening, Liu Xubai went to Su Qinghuan's yard as promised. When I opened the courtyard door, the fragrance of plum blossoms hit my face - a few buds on the old plum tree quietly bloomed in the dusk, and the pink and white petals trembled slightly in the golden sunset, like butterflies that had just woken up.
Su Qinghuan had already placed the food on the table in the main hall. The four dishes and one soup are countless times richer than the bone soup in Qingshi Town - a plate of stir-fried spiritual vegetables, a plate of braised spiritual animal meat, a bowl of steamed eggs, a plate of pickled crispy bamboo shoots, and a steaming casserole of mushroom soup. Two pairs of bowls and chopsticks, two cups of tea, simple but not perfunctory.
"These are all sent from the kitchen?" Liu Xubai sat down at the table, a little surprised.
"I cooked the food myself." Su Qinghuan sat down opposite him, picked up the chopsticks, and said in a calm tone, "Among the disciples of Liuyun Peak, my cooking skills rank higher than my swordsmanship ranking."
Liu Xubai picked up a chopstick and put the braised pork into his mouth, and then froze. The meat was crispy and flavourful, and the sauce had just the right amount of salty and sweet. It was better than the braised pork he had eaten in any restaurant in his previous life. He looked at Su Qinghuan and didn't know what to say for a moment.
Su Qinghuan lowered her head to pick up the vegetables, not looking at his expression, but the corners of her mouth curved in a very slight arc.
The meal was quiet. Neither of them mentioned anything about the sect, the elixir, or Han Zhiyuan. They just talked about some insignificant topics over the food and tea - when would the snow on Liuyun Peak melt, how many plums could the old plum tree bear this year, and how long would it take for Chen Yan to recover after removing the splint on his arm before he could practice sword practice. The sky outside the window changed from golden orange to gray-blue, and then from gray-blue to deep black. The aroma of plum blossoms floated in from the courtyard, mixing with the remaining warmth of the food, making the entire hall feel warm.
After finishing the meal, Su Qinghuan cleared away the dishes. When Liu Xubai helped her carry the casserole back to the kitchen, he suddenly asked: "What does the little cicada look like?"
Su Qinghuan paused for a moment, then continued washing the dishes: "Round face, dark skin, as tall as my shoulders, and a mole on the corner of her left eye."
"Got it."
Su Qinghuan turned her head and looked at him, with a trace of confusion in her eyes.
"You said that Xiaochan works as a handyman in the kitchen of Hantan Valley. The kitchen of Hantan Valley is also the kitchen of Huamei Sect. Disciples of Liuyun Peak cannot transfer people out of bounds, but foreign guests from the guest house go to the kitchen to ask for a bowl of hot water. It does not cross the line." Liu Xubai wiped his hands dry and said in a casual tone, "I have a habit of going to the kitchen to get hot water myself."
Su Qinghuan looked at him and said nothing for a while. Then she turned around and continued washing the dishes, her voice low: "Don't rush in. Han Zhiyuan is eyeing you, and there will be people watching you wherever you go."
"I know." Liu Xubai leaned on the door frame of the kitchen and looked at the old plum tree in the yard. The starlight fell on the plum branches, dyeing the blooming petals silvery white. "But some things have to be done by someone."
He turned around and walked towards the courtyard door, his hand habitually resting on the new green sheath sword on his waist.
Done very naturally.
